payload.summary: Virtualize long document and differential diagnosis result lists
payload.detail: In src/components/documents/document-search-results.tsx and src/components/differentials/differential-stream-workspace.tsx, large clinical queries returning 50-200+ cards mount all DOM elements at once, elevating memory and causing scroll stutter. Introducing virtualized windowing (e.g. @tanstack/react-virtual or windowed DOM pagination) maintains a constant DOM footprint (~10-12 cards) while preserving full keyboard and screen-reader accessibility.
